description: This file defines the UAManager class which adds PDF/UA (Accessibility) support to a PdfDocument in the PDFsharp library. It manages the structure tree for accessibility features, handles page events, and provides methods for accessibility-related operations within a PDF document.

classes.name: UAManager
classes.description: Manages PDF/UA (Accessibility) features for a PdfDocument, including setting up the structure tree and handling page events.

methods.name: UAManager.ForDocument
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the universal accessibility manager instance for the specified document.

methods.name: UAManager.SetDocumentLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for the document's accessibility features.

methods.name: UAManager.BeginTextMode
methods.description: Switches the current graphics context to text mode for accessibility annotation.

methods.name: UAManager.BeginGraphicMode
methods.description: Switches the current graphics context to graphic mode.

methods.name: UAManager.IsInTextMode
methods.description: Checks if the renderer is currently in text mode.
